item.title: Work In Progress - Robert Reich new Movie — Wed Oct 7, 6:00 PM — Sebastiani Theatre
item.description:
“The Work in Progress” takes viewers on a tour of the American spirit at a time of deep division. Guided by UC Berkeley emeritus scholar Robert Reich, the documentary finds tension and doubt everywhere — but also signs of hope.Inspired by Robert Reich's curiosity and humanity, it is a testament to the power of listening, civic engagement, and the belief that our shared future is still ours to shape. Th film begins with Professor Reich asking "What do we owe each other?" What follows is a journey to find out.
A Q&A with producers Heather Kinlaw Lofthouse, a UC Berkeley graduate, and Elliot Kirschner will follow the film
The film is a timely and thought-provoking addition to Reich's catalogue of writing, film, media appearances and other public commentary. Perhaps it's no surprise that it emerges from the culture of UC Berkeley. Join the City of Santa Rosa and Los Cien Sonoma County for a community meeting on the 2026 Municipal Election. Learn about Measure L, learn about City Council representatives, and find out how to make sure your vote counts. Spanish interpretation and light refreshments will be provided, so register today to reserve your spot.
Español:

Conoce sobre la Medida L, a los representantes del Concejo Municipal, y cómo asegurar que tu voto cuente. item.title: Frank Lloyd Wright Civic Center Tours — Fri Oct 9, 10:30 AM — Civic Center
item.description:
Price: Adult $10, Senior/Full Time Student $5 \(Plus a $2 p er ticket service Charge Online\)
Ticket Info:
Sponsor: Marin Center
Link: http://www.marincounty.org/depts/cu
The Frank Lloyd Wright-designed Marin County Civic Center is a national- and state-designated historic landmark. Ninety minute docent-led tours of the Civic Center are offered every Wednesday and Friday at 10:30 am, leaving from the second floor Café, Room 233. The cost is $10 adults and $5 seniors and students. No reservations are required. Groups of ten or more can arrange a private docent tour by calling the Visitor Services Office at \(415\) 473-3762.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Funky Florals | Cut Paper Collage Workshop with Sally-Ann Langley — Sat Oct 10, 1:00 PM — Petaluma Arts Center
item.description:
Get ready to play with color, pattern, and shape in this fun, whimsical collage workshop! You'll create your very own Funky Floral artwork using painted papers, colorful patterns, and playful floral and leaf shapes.
You'll make your own painted collage papers, add colorful patterns with paint pens, then get snipping and cutting your flowers and leaves. From there, you'll experiment with composition and arrange your pieces into a funky floral design that's uniquely yours. Create a 9x11 artwork or a collection of notecards and gift tags!
The emphasis is on having fun and playing with your creativity, even if you've never created a collage before. Sally-Ann will demonstrate each step and cheer you on along the way.

item.title: Hey Jude — Sat Oct 10, 1:00 PM — Vino Godfather
item.description:
Attention all Beatles fans in the San Francisco Bay Area! Get ready to experience the magic of the Beatles live on stage with Hey Jude, an exciting Beatles tribute band. With their remarkable talent, great harmonies, and passion for the music of the Beatles, Hey Jude will take you on a journey through the timeless classics that defined a generation. From "Hey Jude" to "Let it Be", every song is performed with accuracy and energy that will have you dancing and singing along.
Their electrifying performances will transport you back in time to the golden era of the Beatles and leave you feeling nostalgic and uplifted. Whether you're a lifelong fan or discovering the Beatles for the first time, Hey Jude is the perfect way to experience the music that changed the world.

item.title: 2nd Planet — Sat Oct 10, 7:00 PM — 4th Corner Speakeasy @ Red Mens Hall
item.description:
2nd Planet, discovered in the year 2000, is a diverse music experience specializing in the styles of contemporary jazz, rock, r&b and funk. The San Francisco Bay area based band consist of 4 musicians who will utilize their creative gifts to electrify music listeners with their original brand of music as displayed in the band’s first CD release “Beyond the Surface” and their second release titled “The Next Level”.
2nd Planet can be found performing in San Francisco Bay area concert venues and also had performed as co-head liner for internationally recognized artists such as guitarist Paul Jackson Jr of American Idol and Jay Leno’s Tonight Show, bass guitar extraordinaire Michael Manring and latin jazz artist Ray Obiedo.

item.title: BEAT: Belew/Vai/Levin/Bozzio Performing the Music of KING CRIMSON — Sat Oct 10, 8:00 PM — Blue Note Napa Summer Sessions
item.description:
Following more than 100 acclaimed performances across North and South America, Europe, and Japan, BEAT returns this fall for the last North American tour. Former King Crimson members Adrian Belew and Tony Levin are joined by guitar virtuoso Steve Vai and legendary drummer Terry Bozzio to perform the music of the three landmark 1980s King Crimson albums: Discipline, Beat, and Three of a Perfect Pair. Rather than attempting to recreate the original recordings, BEAT brings this extraordinary music to life with the spirit, precision, and adventurousness that made it so enduring. Whether you've lived with these albums for decades or are discovering them for the first time, this is the final opportunity to experience one of progressive music's most celebrated catalogs performed by four of the best musicians on the planet.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Oct 11, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian
